title: Desk Training Notes: Combining Rate Discounts by Program on the FarmLand Variable-Rate Mortgage (Farm Real Estate Loans)
content:
**The rule.** When automatic debit is authorised on a FarmLand Variable-Rate Mortgage (Farm Real Estate Loans), how the discounts combine depends on the program they come from: for a member whose StartRight Operating Line is in active status, the autopay and relationship discounts are added and capped at the product's discount cap, and the young-farmer land discount is then added outside the cap; for a member without an active StartRight Operating Line who holds an operating line in active status on AutoDraft, the autopay and young-farmer discounts are added and capped, and the relationship discount is then added outside the cap; for any other member, all the discounts are added together and the total is capped at the product's discount cap.

The program is read from the member's Operating Lines of Credit records: whether a line on the StartRight Operating Line product is in active status, and whether a line in active status is enrolled in AutoDraft.

## Questions the rule answers

**Which discounts sit inside the cap when the member has an active StartRight Operating Line?**
The autopay and relationship discounts, added together and capped at the product's discount cap; the young-farmer land discount is added on top, outside the cap.

**And with no active StartRight Operating Line but an active operating line on AutoDraft?**
The autopay and young-farmer discounts are added and capped; the relationship discount is added on top, outside the cap.

**And for every other member?**
All the discounts are added together and the total is capped.

## Worked figures (hypothetical discounts, cap 0.5)

| Member's operating credit | Discounts | Combined |
|---|---|---|
| Active StartRight line | autopay 0.15, relationship 0.125, young-farmer 0.5 | 0.15 plus 0.125 is 0.275, within the cap; plus 0.5 outside the cap: **0.775** |
| No active StartRight line; active line on AutoDraft | autopay 0.15, relationship 0.125, young-farmer none | 0.15 within the cap; plus 0.125 outside the cap: **0.275** |
| Active line not on AutoDraft | autopay 0.15, relationship 0.05, young-farmer none | all together 0.20, within the cap: **0.20** |
| No operating line in active status | autopay 0.15 | **0.15** |
| Active StartRight line | autopay 0.15, relationship 0.40, young-farmer 0.25 | 0.15 plus 0.40 is 0.55, capped at 0.5; plus 0.25 outside the cap: **0.75** |
